reference.pathophysiology: Venous stasis and hypercoagulability clot calves that embolise to lungs; APLA and HIT immune-clot recurrently, and mismatched or overloaded transfusion injures lungs through TRALI and TACO.
additionalDifferentials: DVT versus cellulitis by duplex and bilaterality
APLA versus HIT by serology and heparin timing
TRALI versus TACO by pressure and BNP
